title: P2-17r submit-artifact: Add submit_artifact as a public Runtime method (master §66); caller is run_compiled_runtime.rs:256
description: Feature P2-17r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-9i6wg). Black-hat review round 1 found that the original bead cited submit.rs as the caller of submit_artifact, but the actual caller is crates/vb_cli/src/run_compiled_runtime.rs:256 inside store_compiled_artifact. The submit path uses put_workflow_source (line 92) and put_run_header (line 126) directly, NOT submit_artifact. Real source: crates/vb_cli/src/run_compiled_runtime.rs:256 (store_compiled_artifact calls submit_artifact), vb_runtime/src/ (submit_artifact is not currently a public Runtime method — it's an internal helper). Master §66 requires submit_artifact to be a public Runtime method so that the IPC layer (vb_ipc) and the CLI layer can both call it through the same code path. This bead: (1) moves submit_artifact from vb_cli's internal helper to vb_runtime::Runtime::submit_artifact (public method), (2) updates run_compiled_runtime.rs:256 to call Runtime::submit_artifact, (3) ensures the IPC layer can also call it. Kani harness: prove Runtime::submit_artifact is idempotent (same artifact → same result). proptest: 100 random (workflow, artifact) pairs produce consistent submissions.
